A foreign tourist stands frozen at the exit, afraid to leave. You show him: just walk.

Face scan, photo, signature, payment: seven minutes, and the passport is posted to you ten days later. You linger at the door wanting to thank someone. There is no one to thank.

Registration, queueing and payment all happen on your phone; while you wait, an AI takes your history, and the doctor needs only five minutes. No pharmacy queue: a little robot cart brings the medicine to the consulting-room door. You remember sitting in a hospital corridor all day as a child.
